articles.title: Letter: Support the Book Exchange Box
body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the May meeting.

Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. To the editor: I have lived on Mulberry Road for 12 years, and I want to say what a difference the Lower Millrace Improvement Group has made.
Please keep the book exchange box in the budget. Many of us on Mulberry Road use it every week.
Keith Emerson, Cedar Hollow
